CustomField.description: Display label used by the FQS Campaign Hierarchy Setup flow's tactical picker. Shows "Suggested Name (under Parent Name)" so overlapping tactic names disambiguate at pick-time. Not used for the actual Campaign.Name — see Suggested_Name__c for that.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The label shown in the campaign-setup flow's Tactical picker. Leave blank on Rollup/Strategy templates and templates that don't need parent disambiguation.
CustomField.label: Display Label
